notes: Connected OSM course candidate. The selected loop is the longest simple source-node cycle after explicit exclusions; its association with a named circuit configuration requires review.
Source way order and shared node IDs are retained. No nearby endpoints are joined and no reference boundaries are read.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 78 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Estimated paired paved-road limits from the pinned licensed satellite image at approximately 0.54 m ground pixel spacing. The retained main route follows the extended configuration and infield branch rather than the separately saved shorter Grand Prix route. Limits follow visible white paint/curb transitions, excluding coloured runoff, desert shoulders, fences and service lanes. Broad turn-one/turn-four pavement is retained where adjoining visible limits widen; these shared-pavement junctions and the branch split around stations 960–984 remain route-selection estimates rather than surveyed racing limits or observed continuous curbs. Both edges interpolate below the bridge between stations 1506 and 1518 (about 36 m); station 1512 is not an observation. Both limits across the tight mapped kink at stations 1632–1641 interpolate between adjoining controls (about 27 m); the station-1635/1638 cross-sections reverse at the curb tip and are not accepted observations. Other linear intervals join sparse corresponding edge pairs with a maximum 50 m observation gap. Original trace, timing and raster terrain remain unchanged. Pixel spacing is not positional accuracy, rendered curbs remain illustrative and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
